Inline markers inside a code span stay literal content

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p><code>a<em>b</em><ins>c</ins></code></p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content() as Any)
```
